verdict.rationale: The evidence shows 1Password stores and shows standard one-time passwords, including QR-code 2FA capture and display on Apple Watch. Nothing in the pack covers Steam Guard codes, HOTP counter-based tokens, or custom periods and digit lengths. Basic TOTP support belongs to a different story and does not count toward this one.

support.subject: As a power user, non-standard tokens work too — Steam Guard, HOTP counters, custom periods and digit lengths
